behavior.explanation: The visible endpoint has two distinct paths. It first resolves the current user and the requested active membership. If targetUser.ID equals currentUser.ID, it skips the administrator check and deletes that membership. If the target differs, it calls requireSpaceAdministrator(callerMembership), which denies when callerMembership is nil or its role is not exactly store.SpaceMemberRoleAdmin; only a successful check reaches deletion. Thus an ordinary non-admin member may not remove a different member on the shown endpoint, while self-removal is separately allowed by the visible endpoint. This conclusion is limited to the shown source path and does not assume deployment middleware or undocumented grants.
